when: A biology process chain — the stages of a process in order.
signals: A backtick run containing → inside a **क्रम:** or **संबंध:** line
`बीजाणुजन ऊतक → पराग मातृ कोशिका → लघुबीजाणु चतुष्क → परागकण`
notes: UPRIGHT body text, never the italic maths face. These are Hindi nouns naming stages, not variables. Horizontal while the chain is short; vertical once it is long, because a horizontal chain that wraps mid-way stops reading as a sequence.
